MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 21

7. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

8. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 30

13. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 66
   C. 17
   D. 34

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 22
   C. 77
   D. 18

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

25. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 41

26. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 9
   D. 4

27. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

28. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 2

29. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

30. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
